text: Implemented dependency-free RdmScorer.Spearman with average-rank tie handling and RdmScorer.PartialPearson with labeled control RDM alignment plus primitive residualization. Added oracle, finite, zero-variance, labeled-control, and RsaAnalysis integration tests. Verified with sbt mvpaJVM/test mvpaJS/test: 36/36 passed on both platforms. Attempted sbt compileAll; it is blocked outside MVPA by atlas provenance compile errors in bd-01KWW08M5510JHY7J6N040GXKR.
